get_dummy_dictionary: create a dummy Dictionary with a specified vocab size for testing fairseq models
get_dummy_task_and_parser: build a dummy task and argument parser to facilitate fairseq model and criterion testing
get_dummy_input: generate random dummy forward input tensors with configurable sequence length, feature dimension, and batch size
get_dummy_encoder_output: create a dummy encoder output dictionary with random encoder_out tensor and padding mask
check_encoder_output: validate that an encoder output dict contains valid encoder_out and encoder_padding_mask tensors
